title: Run and act record entry (DEL-04-03 OUT-001) — PROPOSED
description: PROPOSED record format of RS-v0.9 §13 (R12-1, R12-2; U-04). RS format 0.1 is the only record container (R14-1): a record is an append-only log of entries, one JSON object per line; every entry carries the common identity elements of RS §3 and one body by kind. The bodies of the checkpoint entry kinds (EXEC CE-1…CE-19) are DEL-02-03's and are referenced by relative path to EXEC's `checkpoint-record-entries.schema.json` (RS §13.3); the settings_version body is DEL-04-02's, referenced by $id. Names are Chirality's own; no host or supplier wire field is selected. No placement, path, identity algorithm or canonicalization is selected (OI-013, OI-014; DEL-03-01 TBD-003): 'method' names a designation only. Recording entries of kind destination_declined is SETTLED by DEL-04-03 ScopeOfWork CLM-004 (R16-1, correcting R12-10); recording boundary_refusal entries is PROPOSED (R12-10, R16-1); every representation here is PROPOSED. The R11 labels include R13-1's and R13-2's. RS-v0.9 (node F-C of run APP-V4-DESIGN-PASS-3-20261001) adds, in place in format 0.1 (R13-4): the A15 relations reviewedDraft and priorRevision, and registeredEntries for one act over several library entries (C-01, R17-11; L-4), replacing relations.derivedFrom; the codexAccount form (C-10); R3 supply forms citing the supplier's own record (R19-1, R19-7); role_limit_observation (ROLE-v0.2 §6.3); R13 settlements 'resolved by supplier' and 'ended unanswered (process exit)' (RECOVERY-v0.2 §8.2); runOpened.follows (R19-2) and the run-end line in R3 (R20-3). Pass 4 (R23-8; run APP-V4-DESIGN-PASS-4-20261003) adds, in place in format 0.1: actKindPerson A16 (decide), actClass 'person's act (V4-PM-04)' and the A16-only relation alternativeChosen, with requestRef required for A16; the decision package's act_request body remains DEL-02-03's CE-4 and is not changed here.

evidenceRef.description: RS §9: a reference, never a copy. Resolution at read is the reader's and is not stored.

person.description: RS §6.1 decision actor. For App-captured acts: the name set in the App, the operating-system account and the Codex account when Codex reports one, marked identity not verified (DECISION-K1 K1-4). codexAccount is the reported email of the ChatGPT account of the Codex home that runs the conversation, or 'ChatGPT account (no email reported)'; plan type is not recorded; an API-key account identifies no person and gives no codexAccount (R18-1 C-10; ACCESS-v0.2 I-6).

runOpened.description: R1, R2, R4, R5a and the declared checkpoints listed as guidance (Phase 1). notStarted: R1 'run not started — no model selected' (R15-1), host-loop runs only. follows: R1 chaining (R19-2), the run that preceded this one in the same conversation, cited as context; it is not part of this run's identity and nothing carries from it.

follows.description: R19-2 (a), (b): 'follows ‹run› in this conversation' — the run that preceded this one in the same conversation (ended by the person, RECOVERY DEF-4, with cause 'completed' where the person ended it after the agent reported the workflow finished, R20-1), cited as context: a relation, not a dependency of this run's identity. Unlike continues (R4-4), nothing carries: no arrival, disposition or act. PROPOSED (RS-v0.9).

derivedFrom.description: WD-v0.8 §6.1: the full identity tuple of the workflow adapted from, never a string (V18-2 m-9; RX). RS spells the tuple's elements in camelCase.

seatRole.description: R5a. App runs: the role in force from DEL-02-04's supply record for the conversation (ROLE-v0.2 §6.1), or 'no role' (R17-9); a same-role fork keeps the source's role (R19-8). Host-loop runs: DEL-05-01 / DEL-02-01.

notStarted.description: R15-1 (DERIVED from V4-HOST-01; representation PROPOSED): a host-loop run that never reaches its first turn because no model is selected. No destination entry accompanies it (LOOP-v0.8 §3.1 F-2 (a); §5.2 MS-02).

enum: change items of a named proposal
objects changed by a named outcome

modelTurn.description: R5 per turn: requested and effective kept separate; an unobserved turn is unknown. A turn's effective value comes only from a supplier report that names that turn; a report that names only the thread is written with scope 'thread' and no turn (HOSTING U-27).

operationEntry.description: R7 (RS §5), core elements only in format 0.1; the full element list of RS §5 maps onto these and onto evidence references.

requestKind.description: ADAPTER §4.6 OM-2 request kinds and LOOP's; R14-3.

reason.description: The reason the outcome carries, e.g. a loop-side parse state (truncated · interrupted · malformed · filtered) or a schema reason (LOOP §7).

oneOf.description: The one wording (R12-10): 'prior act not counted', with its reason.

The labels 'waiting — re-held, lapsed after resume' and 'hold not enforceable' are governance-phase labels (RS R8): written only for a governed checkpoint in the governance phase, never in Phase 1 (RQ; V19-A n-6).

dispositionChange.description: CE-18 body (EXEC), with RS's structured annotations (R14-1).

humanAct.description: RS §6.1. Written only from capture evidence (HA-1). A15 is the registration of a workflow revision (R12-5).

alternativeChosen.description: A16 decide (R23-8; pass 4, PROPOSED): the identity of the alternative the person chose, one of those the decided package (requestRef) names; a reader rule checks membership (RS §6.1).

priorRevision.description: A15 (R17-11; C-01): the revision this one follows in its slot (K-6), as RS's workflowTuple, or null for a first revision. WD's derived-from (the parent workflow identity) is not this act's relation (R17-11; C-21).

registeredEntries.description: A15 over several library entries in one act (DECISION-L L-4; R19-4): each entry with the bound subject it registers, its reviewed bytes and its prior revision. Entries correspond one-to-one, in order, with boundSubject and boundContent, and each reviewedDraft.content equals its boundContent (WR ID-2): a reader rule (RS §14.2 R-7). PROPOSED (RS-v0.9).

allOf.description: A15 (R12-5; R17-11; C-01; L-4): the bound content is the reviewed content identity, equal to the revision identity (WR ID-2); the relations name the reviewed draft and the prior revision (or null), for one entry, or registeredEntries for several. relations.derivedFrom is not an element of this kind (refused by additionalProperties).
The A15 relations are A15's only (RS-v0.9).
A16 decide (R23-8; pass 4, PROPOSED): names the decision package it decides (requestRef, the package's act_request entry) and the alternative chosen.
The A16 relation alternativeChosen is A16's only (pass 4).

carriedCall.description: LOOP-v0.8 §5.3 DF-1: the call the destination request carries (operation reference); required for scope once (ACT ND-A2). PROPOSED (node B5).

modelServiceClass.description: LOOP-v0.8 §5.3 DF-3 A-1 and R12-7 (N-OPEN-1): for a contact allowed by the model choice, the class the person's model choice states; never inferred from the address. PROPOSED (node B5).

destinationDeclined.description: Recording SETTLED by DEL-04-03 ScopeOfWork CLM-004, which names destination declined among the network-destination events the format receives from DEL-05-01 (R16-1, correcting R12-10); this representation is PROPOSED. The decline is also reported to the agent (V4-EXM-23).

reportedToAgent.const: destination not allowed by the person

stage.description: LOOP-v0.8 §5.3 DF-4: where the native layer refused. PROPOSED (node B5).

statelessEvidence.description: LOOP-v0.8 §5.3 DF-7 (SE-1…SE-3) for an MCP server; its limit is the R11 label 'stateless revision declared, not verified'. PROPOSED (node B5).

suppliedGuidance.description: R3: per thread and turn, the source identity and content identity of each guidance input supplied; supplied is not adopted (adoption is always unknown). App runs (RS-v0.9): role guidance supplied at conversation start, or inherited at a same-role fork, cites DEL-02-04's supply record (ROLE-v0.2 §6.1) and its limit account (§6.2); the workflow supplied per run as a text element of the run-start turn, and the App-written run-end line on the next turn when no run starts with it (R20-3), cite DEL-02-02's run_text record and state its supply_check against Codex's history, read with thread/items/list (WR-v0.2 §16, §16.6 SC-3; R19-7; R21-4). Each cites its supplier's record by reference; RS does not embed it (RS-v0.9 §4 R3).

supplyCheck.description: R19-7, R20-3: the state of DEL-02-02's supply check of the turn text against what Codex's history returns for that turn, read with thread/items/list (WR-v0.2 §16.6 SC-3 `supply_check`; R21-4), or 'not checked'. 'verified' means the text was supplied as composed; adoption stays unknown.

nativeTurn.description: CC-RS-WR-SUPPLY-FIT: opaque native turn identity, paired with thread and resolved WR supply_check. Never an integer ordinal or a conversion of turn.

allOf.description: App supply forms cite the supplier's own record.
A workflow run-start text or run-end notice states its turn and its supply check (R19-7; R20-3).

examinationFindings.description: R10: A3 findings by reference; never 'host checks passed', never A4.

toolPermissionSettlement.description: R13 (A14; App runs only): the settlement and its origin. Never a human-act record, never a grant. RS-v0.9: 'resolved by supplier' (DEL-01-01's observed fact; OBS-2 O-3 at 0.158.0) and 'ended unanswered (process exit)' (DEL-01-02's custody fact request_ended_unanswered, with its context; RECOVERY-v0.2 §8.2) are settlements by no one: never an answer, never a decline by the App (R17-9).

compatibilityReportRef.description: R14: reference to a required-tool compatibility report evaluated for the run.

destinationRequestClosed.description: LOOP-v0.8 §5.3 DF-6: how a destination request ended other than by a grant in force or a decline. PROPOSED element (node B5); for 'not granted' after the person's grant the refused A12 is its own human_act entry.

enum: constraint not carriable on this host
act offered without a capture-evidence reference

workflowTuple.description: WD-v0.8 §6.1 identity tuple in RS's spelling (`workflow-declaration.schema.json#/$defs/workflow_identity`: source_root → sourceRoot, derived_from → derivedFrom, revision_method → revisionMethod). A derived-from tuple names the workflow adapted from (RX).

roleLimitObservation.description: R3 limits (RS-v0.9): a stated limit of the role in force observed not kept, e.g. L-TASK-1 'a task agent does not delegate' at a spawnAgent item (ROLE-v0.2 §6.3 DL-1). Written when the conversation serves a run (DL-4). Nothing was prevented (DL-3); the standing is carried as handed (C-08). Never a human act, a refusal or a defect of the run. PROPOSED.

reviewedDraft.description: A15 (R17-11; C-01): the reviewed content as WR's ID-3 string — 'draft:<location>:<name>@<content identity>' for a reviewed draft, or 'entry:<location>:<name>@<content identity>' for a library entry reviewed in place (WR-v0.2 §4.7; L-4) — with location 'project' or 'user', and the content identity it was reviewed at. WR keeps its internal draft-key object and writes this string through the RS writer.
